features.title: Magic of performance
features.text: Bards weave occult magic into music, poetry and wit. They lift allies, rattle enemies and have a skill or spell for almost any social problem.

features.title: Composition spells
features.text: Compositions such as a courageous anthem can be kept up every turn for very little cost, making the whole party hit harder or stand firmer.
